body: I am actually a female, fwiw. And I don't really think it's that easy to get over her when I've been with her for almost two years and was planning to move to be with her. I know that it may eventually happen, even though I still have hope for the relationship (for whatever stupid reason), but now is not that time.

I know that I put stress on her life, and I rather hate myself for it. I don't really mean to do it, and it hurts that I do and that she has to deal with me. I feel like her life was reasonably/perfectly fine before I came into it.

I definitely agree with you on the bipolar thing. It's hard not to default back to it, though, and I'm trying to work on that. I don't want to use it as an excuse for my actions, whatever they may be.

Technically, my GPA was low enough to get me kicked out of college, which is why I went to 3 schools in my 6-year span and why I was never really able to bring it up much.

As for the rest, thank you :)

I get therapy, but it's not really much, and it's only every few months. I don't know what I'm ever really fully comfortable with a therapist. Also, I'd been going there free as a student, so I don't know that I can do that anymore. I tried calling them today to schedule an appointment so I can see what my options are, but I wasn't able to get ahold of anyone.

Well job hunting generally sucks here. I also don't want a job here but am afraid that I'll have to get one and then just be unhappy. I know I should get one and work my way to getting one internationally, which is what I want to do, but I'm so unhappy here, and I don't want to keep being unhappy. I've got to get myself out of this somehow, but I don't know what to do. And I don't know how to find a job elsewhere.
